text: This place calls itself a New York deli. What a joke. Worst Ruben I have ever eaten. Way overpriced and corned beef was in chunk . Potato lattes tasted like they were a month old and heated in a microwave. We drove 30 miles to find this place but never again. We experience we have had at a so called deli.
The restaurant owner, Chin P Liu was indicted for human trafficking, tax evasion, and prostitution charges.   Look up details on Trentonian.com

My wife and I went for our Valentine's Day and we had a good dinner, it doesn't look like much food but it is. The 4 course meal was enough but I wish we had more of some of the things, like our deal had said a lobster tail and we each got half a lobster and for pasta two raviolis. I kind of wish the portion was more on those than the others. I'm not too big on fondue but my wife loves fondue so she was happy.

I don't have much to say about this place. It looks nice from the outside. The inside just feels strange, but luckily for them I don't rate on ambiance.

The food is sad. It's like Taco Bell married a cafeteria and then they tried to make it nice by not serving it in To go boxes or on trays.

The food came out colder than the plates which makes me suspect that they microwave everything. 

One of their enchiladas is stuffed with avocado, just avocado. It's bizarre.

I ordered a Durango burrito and I didn't hate it, but it also reminded me of the inside of a frozen shredded beef burrito. I don't hate frozen burritos, but If I want that, I'll just make it home.

The service is chaotic, I mean the servers are nice, but there were a bunch of random people bringing out our dishes and they all were wearing random clothes. It just felt weird, seeing that the place is trying to play it's self off as "nice" (based on the decor).

We went here as a last resort, but I would have probably been more satisfied going to a Taco Bell and calling it a night... and I don't even like Taco Bell. 

I'm giving and extra star because they have free chips and salsa.

I didn't take pics.

Looking for a quick bite near KIPP Wisdom for lunch pulled up my trusty Siri what's near me request and it suggest Mayo Ketchup. I discovered that they served Puerto Rican  cuisine so I walked up to order, a friendly young woman said we usually do on line ordering but I will take your order. I order a chicken mojito. They usually only serve beef but they made a chicken for me . It was delicious and the service was fast and friendly I will definitely return.
This place is a gem! Beautiful outdoors and excellent food. The pretenders and chips and pizza.....you can't go wrong!

Great food. Small place. Low noise level, at least until some bar hoppers hopped in.  I would classify as $$$$, not $$,   but here its worth it. 

My quail was excellent. Wifes lobster ravioli was too.   Looked for the venison but it was gone. Usually something unusual on the menu.

Go here it's amazing!!! The food was hot, fresh and delicious! I got the French Toast and the burn on it was perfect! It was one of the best vanilla lattes I've had to date. Fast order and even faster on the food. I have no complaints! I will 100% be back!

I've been here a time or two before and did not think much of it. It's pricey and a bit too "frou frou" for my taste. I really just thought this place was another West End over-the-top restaurant. While in the area again, I figured I'd give it another shot, because everything deserves a second chance.

I've only dined in for breakfast, but have heard people rave about the lunch and dinner menus. They had salads, sandwiches, wraps, and other great options. They had a plethora of unique side options that looked so dang good--from chicken salad and kale salad to Thai meatballs and chicken tenders. It all looked (and tasted) so fresh. They have options for all sorts of diet restrictions and allergies, and a small shopping section with fun & unique juices, chips, and snack options.

The Thai meatballs and kale salad were TO DIE FOR, so fresh and so delicious--a must try...kale lovers and kale skeptics will enjoy it. I ordered a chicken wrap that was funky and soggy, and not the best--I threw it out because it just didn't taste nearly as good as my sides. The ambiance here is very cute, matching the food, a perfect place for that perfect Instagram snap.
I was excited to try this place since it opened. Unfortunately the food was subpar. Two entrees for a takeout lunch. Both lacked flavor and were disappointing.

Yes! So glad we made it here and so glad they were still open and operating during all the chaos of the worlds current affairs. The staff is super friendly and the baked goods are absolutely delicious. We're from down south and we're visiting for the holiday weekend. We decided to stop in for breakfast on our way to our next destination and ended up getting some food at Lucy's next door as well. It's in a shared suite so it's literally just the same location. I knew when we stopped in here on the way to Clearwater/Tampa that we'd have to stop back in on our way home. We did just that. On the first visit we came right before the Saturday breakfast rush and were able to beat the line of regulars. This is quite a popular spot and there's no wonder why. I got a few savory foods to share with my husband as we also split some breakfast from Lucy's. When I came back in the following day, I wanted to try something sweet. I picked the Death By Chocolate Bar and the S'mores Bar. Both were very good and were a nice portion for the price. I really wish I could come here more often. I know there's other locations and I'm hoping maybe the owners will think about opening up in south Florida. Maybe somewhere near Deerfield Beach?? Wink wink.

Ordered takeout for a family of 5 tonight and could not have been more impressed.  We ordered vermacelli bowls, pho and other assorted side dishes.  Their online ordering system is super easy and one of the best I've seen.  The preparation was efficient and the pickup was contact-free.  When we came home to open up the order we could not have been more pleased...all food was fresh, hot and delicious!  DD Mau is amazing and we will return again sometime soon.
Excellent service! Great menu for vegetarians. This was a great meeting place for people with different dietary preferences.
Five stars to start of for the GREAT customer service! Attention to detail, and energy from the cashier. Ordered my meal to go and came out perfect as ordered. Will always come back to graze

My favorite SUPER underrated brunch in center city because of their creativity, comfyness, and modest vibe. I like it better than Honey's and it's just as good as Green Eggs if not better...for a little bit less money and less well-known. I love the flavored whipped creams and yogurts they make and their pancakes are the best--a crispy edge with the ingredients packed in...the ricotta ones have ricotta you can see. The cheddar chive pancakes rock too. I judge a diner's pretentiousness off the price of their coffee and Little Spoon passes the test. Theres a big menu and rotating specials, so Im always craving something new to try here and try the next thing, or just come back for a coffee.
Wine and food is amazing! Our server, Nikolos W was amazing with recommendations and overall vibes. I highly suggest you ask for him as your server because it made our experience ten times better!

Poor management, rude staff/bartenders. An embarrassment to the old Columns. I used to come here for years, and I'm appalled with the service here. Y'all, get it together...have you really worked in the service industry? Embarrassing.

Great esthetic! Love the modern free spirited vibe of this coffee shop. It was definitely packed. They have indoor, outdoor and upstairs seating. You can order breakfast too but I came for coffee after my workout. The employees are nice and welcoming. They also have a very nice menu of morning drinks and food.

Excellent dining experience! Flavors were wonderful, beautiful presentation. Wok chili beef was delicious as was pumpkin soup and edamame dumplings. Staff was attentive and they are following Covid protocols well. Outdoor dining was great.
Love it here.  One of the better pizza places in the area.  Big fan of the "Trenton" style square pizza

I really wish I hadn't.  Eating at the airport was probably the worst decision I made that day - why didn't I forgo arriving early, and eat somewhere outside the airport?  My husband is clearly rubbing off on me if I'm feeling compelled to get to the gate 5 minutes before boarding.
Service was, well, I was served, and she wasn't rude or anything, but she clearly could have cared less.  I felt so sick after my meal - not like, food poisoning sick or anything - just "UGH, why did I do that to myself?" sick.  The food didn't taste bad - it just tasted like a bad decision.

Me and my sisters came for Juneteenth and I'm so glad I did. They were only letting a few people in at a time to come in and order (thank god) and there were so many people and we didn't even wait that long. You can order a-la-Carte or get combos. We got a dinner pack that serves 4 people. There was only 3 of us but the amount of food we got could probably feed 6 and it was only 43.99. The woman taking our order was so sweet also! I highly highly recommend this place if you're looking for good BBQ in Tampa.

Another excellent meal. They never disappoint. The meats are always tasty and cooked perfectly, tender and juicy.  Love the rice and vegetables. A great variety to chose from and even family package options are available. Great desserts to choose from.

They make you feel like family they are very genuine and nice to talk to. Fresh tasty food and very clean. Implementing and taking all precautions with the virus. Delivery, curbside, pickup. This is one of the best places in Oro Valley for a good quality meal located in the plaza with Frys at La Canada and Lambert. You will not be disappointed. We are so lucky we live so close and do take out more often than I review. 

The pita is so pillowy soft and goes well with all the dips that are delicious from baba ganoush (eggplant)  hummus (chickpea), or mast o khiar (yogurt).  Which any one of those dips can be a meal in itself and so healthy for you if you wanna skip the meat or enjoy it with a combo plate.

The Black Sheep was phenomenal. Ruben and Carina took amazing care of us and curated an amazing dining experience. 

You're greeted at the door by an alluring blue light and a statue of a large black sheep. The decor of the restaurant is perfect for their style. 

Our low ABV cocktails were great (slightly on the sweet side, so be prepared) the Gin and Germain had a nice bright fruity flavor. Their take on a margarita tasted like a Thai Margarita, it was delicious, with mottled bell pepper and basil.

 We shared the prosciutto gnocchi, fried cauliflower, the crudo, and the bone marrow bruschetta, all were superb and delectable. 

We will be back!

During these uncertain times, i.e., Covid-19 era, it's always nice to meet people who remain positive and hopeful. Like most restaurants, Mission's is offering curbside and delivery service but what Missions is also offering is a friendly smile and compassionate heart. Melissa, the lady who not only took my order via phone but also greeted me with a warm smile when I arrived, was nothing short of exemplary in her customer service etiquette. 
In knowing that I had walked from home to pickup my meal in the sweltering eighty-something degree weather, Melissa was also kind enough to offer me a complimentary soft drink with my meal. But it didn't come in just any cup, it was a refillable cup. She's awesome. She proves that it's the small things that count and make all the difference. I couldn't have chosen a better dining establishment to get some down home comfort food for the soul than Mission's. And like always, it's worth the money.
Really good food! The shrimp dumplings is amazing, and soy milk and youtiao are so crispy and delicious
This place is being replaced by a sushi restaurant called Megu Sushi, opening Feb 17.

Definitely not a steakhouse. How can this place call themselves a steakhouse and not know how to cook meat.  

Steak under seasoned, to charred, and not cooked as requested.  



Salmon, only saving grace is the parmesan cheese on top. Otherwise you would need to spit it out.  

Lamb chops, oh dear disgusting no flavor and again not cooked as requested.  The

Will the owner of Charley's please step forward and acknowledge your restaurants need help.  You need to hire a chef who really enjoys and knows how to cook.   It is unfortunate that your other staff has to apologize for your mistakes.  

My advise is hire an amazing chef for your restaurants.

Service is good. People are very nice. Arroz con gandules was bland. Lechón was bland.  Monfongo a criollo con ... was good.  Stew dishes with rice were good as well.  Alcupperia was good as well.  3 stars. Nothing was four or five star good.  Overall, seasonings need to improve.
Great food and margaritas! You can't go wrong with the street corn, guac and fish tacos.

My daughter and I ate at Jackson's tonight.  I wasn't sure about it since it only had 3.5 stars but it was the closest to the hotel.  We sat outside and Sequoia was our waiter.  He was great! We ordered the Edamame with parmesan.  I love edamame but didn't quite understand the parmesan.  I had a great glass of wine.  For dinner I had the grouper with lump crab meat which was delicious!! I had a side Caesar salad.  My daughter had the grilled cheese which she ate almost all of it.  It was a great view and delicious food!

1 and a half hour wait for 2.2 mile delivery only to receive cold, burnt pizza and burnt fries (they were almost brown) with almost no cheese and topped off with the  worst customer service $50 down the drain on food that sucked
Friendly staff, excellent food. Cozy atmosphere. Excellent outdoor patio with ample seating, and baby friendly!

Thought we would check this new place out for lunch. The food was very fresh, right off the wok, delicious, and reasonably priced. The servings were very big! My shrimp fried rice had a lot of shrimp!! Lady who waited on us was friendly. Bathrooms weren't the cleanest. There is seating for a small crowd. I saw that Grubhub delivers here to Mooresville area for $1.99. Only thing I would have preferred was maybe a real plate, just something other than styrofoam. We are happy to have this new establishment in town.

I've been to shake shack's all over the country and they're great. The Nashville location, not so much. There's always something weird. Out of straws. Only have one flavor of shake. Tonight they stopped taking orders altogether - at 7 pm on a Friday night 

UPDATE: decided to give it another try. Craving a chocolate shake in my way home. Guess what they were out of tonight? Chocolate shakes. Disappointingly consistent.

Food: 4.25 Out of 5
My partner and I celebrated her birthday with a be-lated birthday brunch! We ordered two lemonades, the 6 Hour Hash, Créame brûlée and the Boardwalk. Everything we ordered was scrumptious! I even found the pork roll with the caramelized onions in the Boardwalk tasty. I'm biased for amazing corned beef and they delivered that in the 6 Hour Hash again! This is the second time I've ordered this dish. Créame brûlé was a perfect dessert for me to end our meal. We spent ~$45 and we were happy to spend it

Service: 5 Out of 5
Jean-Marie was our server and she was fantastic!

Environment: 5 out of 5
Thank God for outdoor seating. It provides us with some sense of normalcy during COVID.

Overall: 4.75 Out of 5
Come by! Great price point and I had left overs for breakfast tomorrow! One of the few restaurants in the area with outdoor seating. Of course the quality is still there and the restaurant folks serving you have high spirits during COVID!
Great pizza and apps the buffalo chicken pizza was amazing we really enjoyed our dinner thanks amore

Read the reviews before ordering- expectations weren't high (just needed to grab a quick dinner close by last minute). Figured a burger and wings would be safe; they forgot the drinks we ordered. Burger was fine but the wings weren't even edible - they weren't completely cooked (raw on the inside). Had to throw out all the wings. Waste of money. Gave two stars as the burger was okay. Do yourself a favor and avoid the wings !

New installment at armature works so I decided to try some of their baked goods. You have to get the espresso cookie when you go!!! It is more of a gooey cookie shaped brownie, but honestly I don't care what they call it because it's so good. Did not really taste too much espresso either but again it was so tasty so it's worth it. The raspberry coconut bar had a good amount of coconut in it which I liked, but the berry part was a little too sweet in my opinion. Also, I noticed that they did not openly label their baked goods that had nuts in them, so I was surprised when there were walnuts in the espresso cookie. I'm not allergic but would hate for someone who has allergies to be surprised like that, so just make sure you ask about nuts when you are ordering.

Subpar and tasteless seafood served at a beautiful location. I would not recommend this place for the food. It was not well seasoned and I could have made a better dish at home. Really questionable that this place is so highly rated on Yelp but that must be because of the location.

All I need to say is, Churro French Toast. I didn't even have time to take a picture because I devoured half of it within a few minutes. Every single ingredient is downright delicious. The way the Nutella is drizzled with the strawberries is to die for. My mom always orders the Arugula Toast. Healthy and of course, delicious. We drive almost 40 minutes just for these two meals!

Great New Place! Definitely fits it's billing as an "EQUAL PARTS RESTAURANT & ENTERTAINMENT VENUE".  The food was great (Mediterranean style). The entertainment (cabaret)was eye popping and incredibly talented. Can't imagine this place not being a big hit in the Philly club/restaurant scene.

Service was excellent and it was a nice "dining experience". The food portions were small but tasty. Overall, this establishment is very overpriced, especially when compared to the similar but better option up the street, Shaya.

Now this is the new revised Bab Cafe in Summit shopping center.  Original "KFC" Korean Fried Chicken is there main entree.  I had the 1 pound just chicken option that you have a choice of white or dark meat with choice of three sauces.  Also ordered the snow chips, which are just like sweet potato chips with some sugar sprinkled on top.  
I felt the chicken could have been a little crispier so maybe if that is your preference then made get it dry with sauce on the side.  Otherwise I think it is a good option in Reno to get some "KFC".  Wish they had the bowls they had before, but those are only available at the other location near downtown Reno.  So be sure to check it out and maybe you will have to visit both locations to try their specific options available.
We checked this off the list on our way out of Nola. They literally only have beignets and coffee. A big space for such a limited menu. Go there and get powdered sugar all over yourself Tony Montana.

Amazing!! Every dish was spectacular and the service was so on point! We came here for dinner and did the $65 fixed menu and it's soooo worth it! You're able to try every little dishes from each the selections. You get 10 courses of your choice ( or ask for the chefs choice) and get one mochi ice cream dessert each. 

I'd definitely would come back! They need to open one in NYC!

This is the best sushi place by FAR in the area; Pon and his crew are artists. Not to mention they are super cool and knowledgeable: Do yourself a favor and eat here. The fish is SUPER fresh and top quality, I've eaten at sushi places across the world and I'll guarantee this is TOP QUALITY by far...

My sweet tooth was kicking in and we wanted to find a place we can have a dessert and a liquor drink. We chose Rock Bottom so we could sit on the patio and watch all the downtown action. The view and the carrot cake did not disappoint.

Visited this restaurant on a Sunday at 6pm and while the restaurant was barely busy, we received very poor service. We ordered 3 drinks from the bar and it took about 30 minutes for them to arrive at our table. Our server wasn't even the one who brought them to us. We then put in an appetizer that was delicious but took another 20 minutes to come out. After an additional 40 minutes after eating our appetizer our 3 entrees came out and they were also very good. The only reason I am giving this review 2 starts is because the delicious food and drinks. 
After we finished our meals and we were ready to pay, we ran into even more trouble with our server. We asked for 3 separate checks before we even ordered any food in the beginning. My two friends wanted to pay with cards and our server totally messed it all up. Turns out, she charged my one friends card on both bills and when we questioned her about it she was totally confused as to what we were talking about. She then took the cards again to resolve the problem and returned saying the manager was figuring it out. After about 20 additional minutes, she returned with the cards and said that both meals were paid for on two different cards which was not true since the total on both checks was the same amount. During this time we were never visited by the manager and the manger never comped anything or explained what happened. She ended up double charging my one friend and that is not ok. This restaurant needs help

Someone gifted me a gift card. First time visiting. I used curbside due to covid. I was planning to order the wings because I heard so many good things about them. Instead I went with the Crab Cake/tater tots platter. The Crabs cakes were horrible! The tater tots were delicious  It came with cole slaw that I instantly spit out. I think it was spoiled! The girl that came to my car with food was full of energy and greeted me with a smile.

I wish I had went with my first instinct and ordered the wings.

I've been wanting to try Buya and it did not disappoint!! Very clean, conscious of social distancing, masks etc. we ordered the Shoshito peppers first. They were perfectly blistered with a perfect mix of smoked sea salt and brown sugar! Yum! The pork dumplings were equally delicious. Not greasy and cooked to perfection. We shared the crispy duck ramen and it was a generous portion. They split it in the kitchen to make it easier. It was loaded with the perfect balance  of duck, ramen and broth. Sara our server was nice and attentive. I can't wait to come back!

Sub service is extremely slow. It literally took 25 minutes (being the 2nd in line) to get two cold subs. That being said they were fine sandwiches, just slow.
Donuts are good but the hype around the apple fritter is undeserved. Every time I've had one they are not cooked through enough- very inside dough, and there is no apple to be found inside, making it a fried cinnamon roll. Which sounds like a good donut but is not an apple fritter. Best apple fritters are at Fox's Donut Den. 
But good glazed and kolaches.

Crabby Bill's holds a lot of fond memories for me.  This is my first time at this location.  I tried the spicy shrimp basket with sweet onion hush puppies and seashore tots.  A glass of fresh Earl Grey iced tea washed it all down.  

The spicy shrimp were very good, tender and with a nice spicy kick.  The hush puppies were very doughy and had very little flavor.  The tots were OK, but would have been much better without the hoop on top (and I requested very little goop).  The tea was great-very fresh.

The service was very friendly and the prices were reasonable.  

Like the Terminator, I'll be back.

I normally get their pizza to-go, but today my husband and daughter had their lunch buffet. Very disappointing. It was probably around their lunch rush I guess you can say since it was just after noon when we arrived, and there were maybe 4 couples/families in there including us. There were 2 pizzas out when we came in with just a few slices of each left. I grabbed some for myself and daughter and should've just grabbed my husbands because by the time he went to grab his it was gone. 3 times in the next 10 min he kept checking back and nothing still put out. When they finally put just one pizza out, it was gone in about a minute and he got one measly slice of pepperoni and jalapeño pizza. This was basically all they put out the next couple rounds, which sucked cause I couldn't give it to my 2 year old since the Jalapeno's were pretty strong. It was a very poorly put together buffet, next to the pizzas are several metal containers of the regular fries, garlic fries and then 3 different options of boneless wings that had more breading on it than chicken. 

A family of 5 came and sat in the booth next to ours at some point in between all this and got tired of waiting for the pizza and went and asked for their refund. The guy actually did it, but the customer was also complaining about the flies that were inside and the guys excuse was, well it's summer and we can't control the flies when we open and close the door. 

There is also another review on here about the restroom not ha

Had some time alone for dinner last night.  Did some research and found the Big Lug. It is a Beer place and I really don't drink beer. When looking at the reviews the food looked spot on.  I eat at the bar and ordered some food.  I had the buffalo dip and chips and the Nashville Hot, spicy garlic wings.  As you can see it looks amazing and the flavor delivered with both dishes.  The price was right and the Blue cheese is always a good choice.  I gave them a 4 which is really strong but you need to be great with the people skills to get a 5.  They talked a lot but mostly with each other and not the 6 people at the bar.  Overall very strong.  I will be back

Best freaking burrito I've had in years. I can't get enough! I've been ordering from this place via doordash at least twice a week and it's always the BEST! My husband took me to an expensive dinner at a high end restaurant tonight and all I wanted was a burrito from here lol, they were closed.   The meat is excellent quality. The spicy red salsa is SO good. I always get the grilled chicken burrito with retried beans, etc. You guys, best Mexican food ever!!!

With all the rave reviews I was surprised to be a little let down! I was so excited to try this place but my husband and I left pretty underwhelmed. First off - the seating by the bar is really the only good place to sit. We were brought to a back room originally and while crowded there was an awkward hush hush feeling back there with no atmosphere. We requested to wait for a table by the lively bar and it was much better. 

We started with drinks - a city wide for my husband and an old fashioned for me. My drink had salted caramel but it was a little too strong for a pre dinner drink. I'd prefer that after dinner more. 

We split a beet salad & the burger with a side of ripple fries. The salad was really bland and too much lettuce. I love a beet salad sans lettuce. The burger was good but the fries left me feeling kinda over full and gross. 

Definitely worth checking out for yourself!

Great experience.  The service was excellent as well as the food.  There is a check in online feature on Yelp that worked great and we were seated as soon as we arrived.  We ordered the mahi tacos and the ahi burger and they were great.  Later we went back and got a flatbread pizza which was also excellent.  Lots of TVs and a great vibe to the place.   Highly recommend.

I ordered the Beyond Pizza, which has Beyond burger meat, basil, mushrooms, and white beans. When I read the menu, I assumed that the pizza had cheese on it (because why wouldn't it), but it does not. I guess since it wasn't listed, that meant it wasn't included. Well, no real problem for me - except that with no cheese, the toppings all rolled off the second I picked up the slice up. The pizza really needs cheese to anchor everything to it. On the other hand, the crust was thin and tasty, the sauce was good, and so were the toppings (which I ate separately since there was no way to keep them on the pizza). My friend's pizza, which did have cheese, looked really good. I'm going to give them another try and make sure this time the pie has cheese on it!

I enjoyed a leisurely brunch of Chicken & Waffles (Crispy Chicken Breast, Blue Corn-Green Chile Waffle, Chiltepin-Mesquite Honey, Tajin Watermelon) along with a non-alcoholic prickly pear cooler on the outdoor patio.  Creative, refreshing, and delicious.  I recommend the Bistro for both the ambiance and the food.
Everythings is frozen and just warmed it up, but not really warm you guys!!!!! Terrible place! Do not recommend

The food is authentic delicious Mexican. However it lacks greatly in the customer service area. After we were essentially abandoned at a booth after a shift change we vowed only to do takeout. That leads me to my most recent disappointing experience, another customer and I stood at the front waiting to pick up our orders and waited for over 10 minutes without seeing any of the employees. We heard people in the kitchen talking and messing around, when she finally came out it was another 10 minutes for her to bring my food out when I had called 45 minutes prior given a estimated 15 minutes.
Shaianne and Sam are the best! Favorite servers at the pub by far. Come here every Thursday just for them

Let me start by saying this is a review of the pizza not the bar or other items on the menu. I've never been here but I've ordered delivery a few times and it was a few times too many. 

For a place called Big Pie the pies are not big in any way. The crust is thin and under cooked. I had the meat lovers and I can truly say I get better pizza from the Racetrack on General DeGaulle.  

I pray you Dave Portnoy never walk through your front door or the 1.3 score he gives you may close you down. I'd sooner sit down to a home cooked meal with Zack Bowen than eat another slice from Big Pie. 

May God have mercy on your souls for pushing that pizza  like product out in to the world.

Best place to get authentic Mexican in the city! Awesome drink specials and you can't beat dollar tacos on Tuesday. The chorizo-queso is my favorite. It's definitely one of my favorite places to stop while visiting.
I have only order to go here.  They have a good online ordering system easy to make your orders and to pick up orders. They are quick and delicious sushi.

READ THIS!!!
Way overpriced, low quality bland food, appetizer ice cold in the middle, poor management. 
I will never go there again, nor will my family and friends. I will make sure to tell everyone who is planning to go, NOT TO GO TO THIS DUMP.

Thai Kitchen is a great place to stop in for a quick lunch on your lunch break because of their lightning fast service, friendly and efficient staff, and delicious, cheap lunch specials!

I've been here a few times for lunch and each time my food is cooked well and they work ultra-fast to ensure that my food is out within minutes of me placing my order. Seriously... this is the quickest service I've ever experienced outside of fast food places! 

The lunch portions aren't particularly large, but they come with a cup of soup and a spring roll, so a lunch plate is definitely filling and the perfect mid-day pick me up. They seem to use plenty of fresh veggies in their recipes, which I really appreciate. Each time I've gone, I've ordered the pad see ew with chicken and mild spiciness and the dish has been consistent and perfectly delicious. Last time, I also ordered a Thai iced tea, which was good but incredibly sweet... more so than most Thai iced teas I've had. If I were to get it again, I would definitely ask for them to cut the sweetness a bit, but I found it was easily fixed by adding water to it. 

Thai Kitchen's menu has all the traditional Thai favorites and they're all gems. Their service is exceptional because it's so fast and they never compromise on quality. Head on over next time you're craving Thai!

We have been to this location several times in the past. Service has always been hit or miss, but tonight has been awful. They ran out of tilapia, but didn't tell me until well after I ordered. My daughter's dinner came out a good fifteen minutes before the rest of ours. When my dinner came, it was cold. They made a new one, but my baked potato and broccoli were undercooked and inedible. The server said she would send the manager over to talk with us. He brought out my food, but never said a word about or apologized for the problems with the food. The only positive was our server who was very nice and apologetic.

Ordered take out yesterday for dinner.  Very easy to order on-line and customize things exactly as you want.  Had a Caesar salad w salmon, the walnut gorgonzola salad w salmon and a chicken cheesesteak.  Easy pick-up; they bring the food nicely packaged right to your car.  My salad w the salmon was excellent.  Everyone seemed to enjoy their choices as well.  Happy to support one of my favorite local places.  Give their take out a try!
I would give this a 10/10 if I could. I highly recommend the Oxtail and Mac N Cheese, I get it every single time.

I love this little restaurant tucked in the small strip mall across from Meijer. All of the ingredients are always fresh and everything is cooked to order. The woman who works up front regularly is super friendly and helpful in deciphering some of the menu items. The prices are reasonable and the place is always very clean and orderly.

Went last night and I will not be back. It was so busy but we were seated pretty quickly for a party of 4. My bf and I placed our order and so did our 2 other friends. Our food came out but our other 2 friends foods took more than 30 minutes. We finally were able to flag down our waiter who never came back to refill our waters and asked why their food hadn't come out and they finally told us their ordering system had crashed, but I guess they failed to mention it to us, so we were just sitting there with no clue to what was happening. I asked to speak with the manager and he came out and gave a bs excuse of that they were understaffed and so busy for our shitty service and experience but did not take any further action. If you're a manager of a restaurant you should probably keep a better number of staff so you dont run into these issues. Needless to say I am very disappointed with my experience last night. Food is good, but service is also of MAJOR importance to me. Will not be back.
Amazing authentic food prepared freshly in view. Very friendly staff! If I could give it higher stars, I would!

Solid place to grab a sandwich. These guys don't skimp on the meat or the flavor when it comes down to it. The Pan Con Lechon add cheese is my personal favorite, but you really can't go wrong with anything on the board. The Borracho Beans got a fair amount of heat to them, so watch out. Super friendly staff. Check this place out.

We have eaten at the Lemon Tree several times and it is always a great experience. It's worth taking a chance when you order food here because they're always doing something interesting, and it always tastes great!

My family lives out of town, and were visiting Nashville to look at Christmas lights. My husband was wanting BBQ, and Edley's was at the top of the list as best BBQ in Nashville. 

This Edley's is located at the edge of a neighborhood, and the parking lot is small. Luckily, we were able to find a spot. The building is very cool, with a modern vibe. 

The staff was friendly! We were sure where to order when we came in the side door, so the woman at the to go counter directed us. The cashier taking orders recommended different things to us, which made us feel welcome as well. 

Food was okay. My husband didn't love the pulled pork. I ordered the fried catfish and it was fantastic. You could tell they bread it and fry it fresh at the restaurant. The sides came in super small cups. For the price of the meal, the value was just not there. The macaroni and cheese wasn't cheesy, but very milky. We both didn't like it, and my two year old said "No, yucky" after one bite. My son had the kids grilled cheese, and it was tasty. He ate about half, and I ate a couple bites of the other half. 

We ordered brisket to go to take home and try. The brisket flavor was good, but not very tender. 

Overall, we spent around $50. I don't know that we would give Edleys a second chance, especially since Martin's BBQ isnt too far away.

This place is great when you eat in , unfortunately we have had 3 bad deliveries, cold pizza , wrong pizza and very long delivery time. I understand they tell you long delivery but at least make the pizza closer to when your actually delivering it. Suck !!  But the pizza is great when you eat in.

First off, the food's excellent. No complaints there at all. I had Shrimp and Grits, while my wife had Chicken and Biscuits. The portion size on the chicken is easily large enough to share. 

The shrimp had the heads and tails on them, so be prepared to do a little deconstruction. No big deal, but you have to get in there with your fingers a bit. 

The Boudin and Cheese Boullettes appetizer was great as well. 

The make your own Bloody Mary bar is well-stocked and the Bloody Mary mix is tasty.

The jalapeño cornbread is fine, but not a "must have."

Definitely make a reservation and don't be in a hurry. From the time we sat down until our entrees arrived was nearly an hour. 

 I'm glad I ordered the appetizer or I'd have been "hangry" by the time we got our entrees. 

The kitchen was pushing the food out, no doubt, and it was hot and fresh when it arrived. It just took awhile. 

I'd definitely go back, but in my experience, I'd take into account the probable wait time for your food to arrive. Show up hungry, but not too hungry.

The name says it all. By far the best New York style pizza in New Orleans. Crust is firm, chewy, bubbly. Perfect balance of sauce and cheese and toppings. We drive all the way from uptown for this pie.

I placed my order online days ago and said I would pick it up at 4:15. I had an almost 45 minute wait before I got my food. When I got home the shrimp scampi was good but it look like it was a lunch portion-if. Fries were supposed to come with the cheeseburger and not a one was in the bag. Of course the cheesecake was delicious. It was very unorganized and we had people  cut in front of us. A fight  almost broke out and for Mother's Day it really kind of ruined the whole


I would like to update my previous review. They did contact me and apologized graciously. They said that I would receive two different things for the experience and they followed through.

This place was probably the most affordable meal we had during our visit to NOLA and it was amazing. Angela  was our waitress and she was fun and very helpful. It was my first time trying the Muffaleta and to my surprise it was REALLY good. We had the gator bites, they come with a really good dipping sauce and we really enjoyed it. In addition, being from Texas we were curious to try the chili and it was really good as well. Angela recommended this beach and black berry drink it was really good and refreshing. I believe they also had bottomless mimosas but didn't have that. She was so welcoming and grateful to just have more business. Local shops have been hurt tremendously by the pandemic, don't forget to support and TIP the amazing people working in the service industry! :)

Something has happened to my favorite soul food spot. Granted, it has been some time since I was in so I stopped in on my way home from work. Things have slipped.  The food all looked and tasted "old" like it was prepared WAY,WAY ahead of time.  I had the ribs and fried chicken. Two small dry ribs and what seemed to be leftover chicken. Mac and Cheese was just ok but was not fresh, The greens were pretty good. The corn was straight from the can with no seasoning or flavor.  
All of the food on display just did not look fresh. I wont rush back. Its a shame because Aunt Berta's used to be so good.

Not paying attention to health protocols for Covid 19.

Facemasks not worn properly - needs to cover nose and mouth not one or the other.

A great place for ramen and sushi! We ordered the shoyu ramen to start. The flavor was savory but can be a touch less salty, but it did not stop me from devouring the whole bowl. I really liked the texture of the noodles in this ramen! Super chewy and soaked up the flavor of the broth well. 

We also got the five for $15 chef nigiri selection. It came with five different raw fish, all of which tasted very fresh! We ended our course with the crab roll. It came with salmon sashimi on top with blue crab and avocado on the inside. To be completely honest, I could not taste the blue crab for the life of me, but the roll otherwise was good! 

Would definitely come back here in the future!

Was pretty excited to try this place since it's recently opened. It was a cool atmosphere and the servers were great but the sushi was disappointing. The sushi rice was hard and I also got food poisoning. Totally fun (sarcasm)

This is the best banh mi in Philadelphia. As fresh as can be, both the bread and the fillings. Ridiculously cheap, yet huge. My favorite is the tofu banh mi but my colleagues have raved about the chicken banh mi. 
Owners are lovely and friendly people. Tiny place, big heart.
Only caveat: cash only.

I am late with this review. February 2019 had this experience.  This restaurant was across the street from our Hotel.  It was packed but the wait not long.  They sit you and attend to you fast.  Very personable and pleasant considering how busy they were.  I had the Rosemary Chicken.  Delicious and recommend it if you are not a Gumbo or shrimp person.  I never like Pecan Pie but our server talked me into it.  OMG!  I ate it all.  It was amazing and I've never had another like it. So unless I go back to NOLA I may never eat pecan pie again.
This is my 7yo favorite place for a special treat. He always gets a cherry soda float. Staff is friendly. Food is good. Desserts are the best.
Not nearly enough meat on the gyro and higher priced than other Greek place in the area

The back patio at the Social is my favorite spot to be in West Chester. There is plenty of space, tables, and heaters. If you are lucky they might even have trivia! I typically order bar snacks and cocktail shakers and have never been disappointed. My favorites are the bacon wrapped, goat cheese stuffed wings and the Pistachio Chicken Fingers. The chicken comes with sweet potato fries and a delicious raspberry cream sauce. My only suggestion would be to open for more hours/days of the week. There have been a few times i wanted to stop in just to find out they were closed.

Restaurant was great and food was great.  Service was not!  They close 10:00 pm on Sunday.  We came in at at about 8:15 pm!  Waitress was clearly pushing us so that she could get out early.  Really disgusting!  I would have left her a 100% tip because of pandemic but she continued to drive us crazy, even while we were eating our main meal.  Please don't ask your customer about desert while eating your crab legs!  Unbelievable.  Hey can't work until ten,  then don't work!  That simple!

This location is back open full time! Yelp, please update.
I went here for lunch over the weekend and kind of got sticker shock. I mean I don't think $15 for a basic hamburger is ok. I was not impressed to say the least. My pasta was almost $20. Yes the pasta was very delicious and good. I just think overall the prices are too high. The other restaurants on Broadway keep reasonable prices. Our server was very lazy and not friendly at all too. I would go stop by one of the many other restaurants. Save your money.

Our go-to steakhouse but may need to look for another as a few new ones are opening up in the area. The good...wait staff was very attentive, friendly and kept the tables and area clean. Top notch. We went at a good time so the wait to be seated was very short. Prices are a bit higher but the quality of food is enough to make up the the small price hike compared to others....Until this last time going. The bad. My party ordered four steaks with add ons. Two steaks ordered medium and those two in the party like boarder line raw, so no issues for them. The other two medium well, little pink inside both came out raw. Mine was raw and chard/burnt on the thinner end. Not much but a spot on a bite or two. Definitely noticable. The other was the rawest of them all. They were bad enough we took most home to recook and eat later focusing on the sides, which were very good. I'm uncomfortable sending food back unless there is no other choice. I don't like the thought of having "special sauce" possibly added to my food when returned. Not saying this place would, but why chance it? We'll go back another time and see how it goes. Everyone has a bad day now and then but if this past experience is it, it's time to move on.

It's BACK! (But better than ever)

My Husband and I have lived in this neighborhood for five years (been coming to Eat here for almost 10) and sadly experienced the decline of Sidecar until the last two visits earlier this year were sooooo bad we swore it off forever, UNTIL we heard the Mike's BBQ crew was involved in the new ownership. We love Mike's and when the new menu came across our insta a few weeks ago we were so excited.

Tonight's visit for the grand reopening did not disappoint. I'm not embarrassed to say we arrived right at 4pm when the doors opened. Friendly staff. Terrific beer list!! I love & appreciate the diversity of options (pet peeve when a place has all IPAs) I had a great Sour and there were Lagers and Wheats and Tired Hands options for the IPAers. 

The food was fantastic. Detroit style pizza was really good even though I was skeptical. One pie could have easily fed 3 or 4 people. We also split a grilled cheese and tomato soup special and honestly we both said we'd come back just for that. Done perfectly and the soup was exceptional. 

The table behind us was raving about the Nashville hot chicken sandwich and the burger slider. That will be next on my list to try. 

We are Thankful the new owners seemed to have turned this place around for the better. So glad we have this local option again. 

Check it out!

We were craving Mac grill chicken parm and some macaroni and cheese bites, so we get there as soon as we open the door and walked in a heat wave hit us . The host says " The air conditioning isn't working at the moment, is this ok?" Which is great he asked and told us the air conditioning isn't working!! So we sat down at a booth, and he takes our drink order. I get a coke and my mom gets an ice water. He brings out the bread and our drinks about a minute later. Them he takes our food order and within 15 minutes he brings the food out. The food was DELISH!! So over all we really enjoyed our time here and it's was pretty good!

Even during Covid-19 this place is still rocking! They are complying with social distancing and face mask guidelines. 
Awesome beer selection, as always! I strayed a bit and tried a canned mojito which was actually pretty good.
Their pepperoni pizza is on point and crispy every time. I love their use of cornmeal on their crust. Hubby and I shared a meat calzone and it was just as good if not better than their pizza. The marinara sauce is sweet and pairs well with the calzone.
As always, fast and friendly service.

Cozy rustic neighborhood eatery and great brunch place. Wait was about 15 minutes during the typical weekend peak. Huge portions and low prices. My wife got the open face biscuit sandwich and said it was delicious. I got the country fried steak and thought it was okay.

COVID-19 indoor dining review: whenever I come back to see my parents in Jersey, this is the only restaurant I insist on coming back to, every time (I actually only recently learned the actual name, we always call it "Amy's place"). Came by for dinner on Christmas Day, and while there were a LOT of cars in the parking lot, people were mostly there waiting for takeout. Inside the restaurant, there were only three small parties (including us), and we were all spaced at opposite ends of the restaurant. The servers all wore masks and stood back when taking your order - felt very safe! 

Always get the spicy fish with silky tofu, the eggplant, the Chongqing chicken, and the beef with spicy peppers. SO much food, with enough for a full meal of leftovers. I've also had a lot of takeout from Szechuan House and the food travels/reheats very well!

Mike and his team do an amazing job! The food was incredible, and we loved being able to sit out on the patio for the fresh air and social distancing. The Pho & Steak Salad we're probably our two favorites, but the eggrolls were also incredible! We had our two little ones with us as well, so this was also kid friendly and easy for them. Highly recommend!

Check your cards when you leave! Left cash at the table for a tip and the waitress took it upon herself to add a 20 percent tip to my card...called up there and the manager said he would refund the tip and that mistakes happen. Super Angry!

This place has a very nice decor, friendly staff, and generous potions of good food. Though it is not really their fault, the phone directions send you to its old location (across the street). I split a chicken parm sandwich and cheesesteak with my wife. Both were very good.

We sat for 45 minutes after placing out food order. The restaurant was not very crowded or busy. The food server was confused on delivering our meal to us, he was not sure if the food he had in his hands was for our table. Very disappointed in tonight visit.

Poor Nashville is dying on the vine. How pathetic this Democrat mayor is screwing up this poor city. Bars are closing by 1030, nobody's here, you have to wear a mask outside. Just horrible and it's sad to see the local economy shutting down. Can't wait to see it back to what it used to be. OK, so the food is still as bad as it was. But I keep coming back for more. Try the patty melt, extra crispy tater tot's. You can't beat the $6 dollar natural lite pictures.

Covid safe- took temp and outside seating. Nice patio area. Started with the queso and chips. The queso is a little spicy but good.  We ordered the fried plantains which were delicious. My husband loved the filet mignon taco and loved it. Came with rice. He said it was the best taco he has ever gotten. Would highly recommend. I got the steak quesadilla. Really good. My daughter in law had the ahi salad and really liked that. Our server,Chase, was excellent. Would definitely come back!!

I ordered the spicy sausage flatbread and the fried chicken sandwich. 

The spicy sausage flatbread is somewhere between a large cracker-with-toppings and a pizza. The dough is very thin. Because it's not of uniform toppingness nor thickness, it gets cooked more crispy in some spots than others. This is unacceptable. 

The parts of the flatbread that were covered in sausage, cheese, fennel, and peppers were quite well seasoned and complex in their spicy, herbaceous, and savory cheesiness. Unfortunately there was not enough of that going on in the flatbread. 

The fried chicken sandwich was the way to go here. The sandwich is stuffed with massive amounts of juicy, well-brined fried chicken. The meat is super juicy and tender inside, and ultra crispy on the edges. 

The bun is soft and buttery brioche. 

Inside are more goodies like slaw and cheese (if I recall correctly).

Such a fun atmosphere watching planes and helicopters take off and land. A great vantage point from the second floor. My chicken and goat cheese biscuit was wonderful and the members in our group that got the omlettes were equally pleased. Service and safety precautions were very good. The only thing that kept it from a 5 star review were the waffles. We looked forward to the chicken and waffles with sausage gravy and admittedly have a high bar compared to our home town breakfast standard. The waffles, although crispy and well cooked, were dense and not very sweet. The "hot" syrup had so many chili flakes in it they overpowered the sweetness of the syrup and gave it an odd texture. That being said, we'd definitely give it another try.

So...it's late on a Friday, dinner with friends at my house and I do not feel like going to all my fave places in Tampa to get all my fave foods for dinner. I'm downtown, so I decide to try this place out and just get all of them at one place. 
The Cuban is to die for. I didn't get them pressed with the garlic butter because I hate the thought of changing something that is already good but she did give me some on the side which I ended up dipping my sandwich into. I will definitely get it pressed with the garlic butter next time. It was divine!
I got the deviled crab which are $8 a piece and worth every dollar. This is not your ordinary Carmine's or Seabreeze or Santos deviled crabs. These actually have crab, a lot of chunks of crab with minimal breading. No, I'm not lying. I quit ordering deviled crab because every time I get them, it's a bunch of breading with a teaspoon of crab. 
The tostones were good, the ham croquettes were amazing!  The papas rellenas were average. The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the yucca fries. They didn't taste like yucca, more like just French fries. The orange dipping sauce is so freaking good. It's like the Latin version of YUm Yum sauce. 
I would definitely recommend this place to anybody and everybody. It far surpasses any of the Cuban sandwiches in Tampa and trust me, I've tried them all.

Excellent service however breakfast took a bit to come to our table.
Good social distancing measurements. All staff was wearing masks.
Food was delicious, plates enormous.
Will definitely come back. 
They don't take reservations but our waiting time was 5 min .
Kid friendly.

Usually this restaurant is very packed for Dinner or on weekends. Last night, my family and I went around 6:15/6:30 PM last night and it actually was not too bad! We were seated right away at a table in the middle. The only minor complaint that I had was that the table was technically meant for a large group, and because we were sat in the middle of the table, we had a random couple come sit next to us, and I could hear their entire conversation (and they could DEFINITELY hear mine). I love the starry ceiling that they have on top near one of the tables, it is very cool and one of my favorite parts about the restaurant. Our waitress was super nice (I don't remember her name). We got complimentary bread sticks with marinara sauce. My minor complaint about the marinara sauce is that it was hard to scoop the sauce and keep it on the breadstick. Other than that, it was delicious. I got French Onion Soup (which was good!) and the Southwest Chicken wrap (but no mushrooms). It was such a big portion, I only ate half and took the other half home to have for Lunch the next day. This is a great restaurant!!

Inside looked very clean, and staff seemed friendly. I ordered take out noodles and thought the food was very good, portions are also large for takeout. I looked that they included a tea bag and fortune cookie with my meal. Will return to try some of the other dishes.

The best Italian food and neighborhood bistro I've ever experienced... I'm from NY and so is the owner.  First time I tasted their food I thought it was authentic NY style Italian pizza and food, and i was right! But with their own unique style and quality , very well done and always good consistent service. It doesn't get any better than this and I've been everywhere.  I order at least a handful of times a month. It's fast it's local and you cannot find any better within a 20 mile radius or more!

I hosted my graduation dinner with 17 guests on a Saturday night and couldn't be more pleased. The entire El Vez staff was spectacular - from planning months prior to the day of. The dishes were served family style and were MORE than enough for me and  all my guests. Everything was delicious and most definitely worth the price. The staff kept the courses coming at a great pace & were very accommodating. El Vez was packed on a Saturday night at 6:30 but me and my guest did not feel neglected whatsoever! I am so happy I had my event here and will most definitely be back again.

I kept going back and forth from 3-5, so I landed in between on 4.  So, by design and price, the assumption is this is a higher end restaurant, and therefore, my expectations are raised.

When we walked in for breakfast, there was no hostess on duty, the guy behind us just sat down at a table.  I got the attention of someone at the bar and asked if we were supposed to seat ourselves, and he ended up getting the hostess who was walking and texting as she approached. (Maybe he texted her??)

She was nice, sat us nearby and our server was there soon after.  Our server was new, so obviously we didn't mind that she had to ask questions about the menu and come back.

What I did mind, is having some weird black thing in my water, she did get me a new one, then my friend asked what options would be best for her diet, but the server gave her odd responses that didn't quite make sense with the question, again, new, and possibly nervous.

When the food arrived I was underwhelmed.  I ordered an $18 eggs benedict and then it came as a hard boiled egg on top??? It was weird.

Anyway, the reason this is a 4 instead of a 3, is because another server stopped and asked how the meal was and when we answered okay, continued to ask the issue.  When I showed her, she brought back the manager, and the manager apologized and comped my meal.

The reason it isn't a 5, there shouldn't have been this many issues at a restaurant of this caliber.

Please read. Food was average.  Would have probably rated this better  if we didn't have a bad experience sitting outside. While we were dining outside the staff was entertaining homeless people by giving them food and turning a blind eye to them eating food off peoples plates that were left out. Even saw a homeless man take a glass water bottle off a table and shower with it. This man then proceeded to steal silverware off the table. This could have all been avoided if the staff didn't let these people hang around in the first place and get them drinks, let them eat off peoples plates etc etc. I do have a heart but the staffs actions deserve a one star, every party that was out there was giving a wtf look at the staff as more and more intoxicated homeless people came through. Yes you heard that right, multiple showed up after they found out the staff was okay with their actions. One table even got free drinks since their server appeared to be embarrassed of the other staff members actions. Very very uncomfortable situation, no one wants to see an intoxicated homeless person stumbling around with a stolen knife in their pants knocking stuff over.

Ok I've been coming to New Orleans for years and this little hole in the wall restaurant puts out some serious good food here. The PoBoys,Gumbo and breakfast are my favorites. Good food for a  good price.

1 - great food
2 - fair prices
3- fun environment
4- genuinely kind people

Every customer oriented business could learn from the authentic kindness one experiences here, be it calling on the phone or exiting the shop as the staff holds the door for you. 

A pizza and a salad are becoming my new "go to".

This was overpriced for what tasted like canned tomato sauce over Italian food. Our waitress was nice, but messed up a couple times. She didn't bring out in the lemons with the water as we initially asked, which is a very minor thing. Then she brought out the wrong meal, probably because the place is so loud she couldn't hear me good. There was no offer to comp the meal and no manager ever came to visit the table once I told her that the wrong meal came out. I ate a small portion of the meal and that was it. She did apologize several times, but we honestly don't plan on returning and wouldn't recommend it. This is my first ever one star post and hopefully I don't have any more in the future.

What a delightful spot right on the bay at Dunedin. 
We had a delightful view from our outdoor table.  Our meal started with a delicious cup of french onion soup, with savory and perfectly caramelized high quality cheese. The soup broth was flavorful as well as uniquely flavored. 
We also sampled a greek salad, which was fresh vegetables, very high quality feta cheese, and anchovies. 
For our main course we had salmon, plated with fingerling potatoes and avocado salsa, and grouper "Bon Appetit", both of which we extremely high quality.  Of note for both dishes was the exceedingly fresh fish and wonderful accoutrements presented with each. 
We did not have room for dessert but will hope to enjoy dessert on our next visit. 
We do intend to return!
Beautiful place and everything I had was delicious and delightful! Definitely coming again!

Not even joking. The cutest place to eat and really great prices. Kid friendly, the servers are extremely nice and personable, Darius helped us, loved him, just everything about this place was awesome and amazing

This place is super consistent! Always friendly, and always on point. No matter which sandwich you order, they will always taste the same everytime you go there. They're deli counter is always clean. They're meat is sliced as you order, they're bread is baked in house and they're cheese is also sliced there. I highly recommend Mike's way! Which is a lot of oil, vinegar salt pepper and herbs. It may seem like alot but the way the bread is baked its purpose is to hold all that liquid and absorb it...have you ever heard someone say " man that thing has too much flavor!" Neither have I, lol...enjoy guys!

It's my birthday today and couldn't go out so we did a pick up (thanks to COVID-19). We ordered the Feast for Five (for four adults). It was only $50! We chose Chicken Parmesan, spaghetti Pomodoro, Caesar salad and rosemary bread. It came nicely packaged, had generous portions, and was so delicious! Sara took our order and was super nice. We look forward to going back in person when we can. I highly recommend getting your take out there while we are stuck inside and beyond! (Sorry no food pictures we were too hungry!).
The food was cold... over priced for the amount of food you receive. My friend received only 8 fries plus the burger was 17$! Insane! I wouldn't suggest if you want authentic Louisiana food.
Very good sushi and excellent service. One the best in town, I definitely recommend it to anyone.

Our first visit was AWESOME! The staff is extremely friendly and they offer a large selection of DELICIOUS FOOD......we will definitely be back!!! We sampled the Cajun Pasta and the loaded potato dishes.......both were extremely good and would be great additions to the already extensive menu!

Another wonderful meal at Enzo's!!!  We just love coming here as the team is so welcoming, not to mention the DELICIOUS food :-). I tried something out of my comfort zone this evening and still glowing!  Rigatoni Alasandra (sp?).  Simply heavenly!!

I really wanted to help out the local restaurants so I ordered three meals from Red Robin who said the would deliver.  I make the order, 2 burgers and one chicken sandwich, and  a tower of onion rings.  After placing the order, I am told they do not deliver.  No big deal I think so I told them I will pick up the order.  Asked the burgers to be well done no pink and the containers say no pink on them.  Both burgers are very pink when I get home to serve them. Hard to understand how they could not get this right when they had plenty of time to get it right.  But they did not have a problem getting the tower of onion rings very over cooked, to a very dark brown, almost burnt flavor.  I sent in a review to the website and today I get an email stating they sent it to the store and regional manager again.  No call from either one, but what they do not know is I never give up until they at least try and use conflict resolution to the customer.  If they do not care to get many bad reviews, then they do not have to call!
Super good food, hospitable staff. Didn't like my beer and they switched it out without a second thought.  10/10 will be back

I love eating everything!! But can't get out of here w/o an Oregon trail cookie!!
Love the weekly specials!! Pot roast bowl was exceptional!!

It saddens me more than one will ever know to leave this 1 start review but I cannot sit back and allow this nonsense to take place any longer. Ever since I can remember Steak-N-Shake has been my "go to" or as one may say...my "pride-N-joy" (pun intended) buuuuut there is nothing in this world that chaps my rear end worse than talking myself into getting out of bed, going through the drive through...only to find out they're closed!!! You have signs plastered all over your building stating "open 24 hours"...not in St Charles you're not!!! This has to be the 6-7 time I've encountered this travesty and its cut me deep...so deep I had to download the yelp app and create an account just to leave my first ever review, a sad one at that. Bottom line...if it's past 10:00pm and you feel like being disappointed, just drive through steak-N-shake and look at all the employees inside while you circle around only to find out they will be open at 7AM while signs and stickers are plastered everywhere boasting the fact they're open 24 hours....they aren't. If anything I Hope this post can save one person the disappointment or betrayal one may feel when contemplating going to SNS late at night. Hope everyone is having a better night than myself...

Was at this location last night with friends for drinks. NEVER again my friends! Don't waste your money. Drink at another establishment or at home. My husband ordered the Tequila sampler and all 3 glasses were practically empty when it was served. The Tequila was also served in brandy snifters. We mentioned it to the server and he seemed annoyed. Seriously....We have been to their Boise Location and had a wonderful experience. The bartender in Boise was friendly, informative and served adequate pours.
Decent breakfast spot. The staff is super nice and accommodating and your food does not take foreVer to come out which is always a plus!

I cannot express, how good Saloon is - but I'll try. If you're looking for the perfect old school, South Philly, date night spot this is IT. 

We have a few couple friends that we've been here a few times with and I have never been disappointed. If you, and once indoor dining opens again, try to snag a seat upstairs. Everything from the red lighting to the wall decor creates the coziest setting. 

We ordered two of the appetizer samplers that come with stuffed clams, veal stuffed poblano peppers, and prawns - I'd highly recommend if you want a little bit of everything (and drizzle some of the oil they give you on top - it's AMAZING!). I'm a big seafood person and always love the Crab Stuffed Salmon, but got the Scallops & Crab in Cognac sauce off their specials menu the last time we went and it was out of this world. My friend got the truffle steak and also raved about it. 

I'm not a huge dessert person, but you really can't go wrong with anything on their menu. And don't skip on an espresso martini to finish things off.

I live in California and have never heard of this place. I gotta say, for the price and the quality of the taste, I like it. I like it a lot actually. The burgers really taste like your cousin grilled it at a backyard bbq and then you had to fix it yourself lol. Can't go wrong with the double burger tray, two sides and a drink for $5 something.
Love then s place and thanks to Mark Miller for the referral!!!  Fantastic product and staff!!!

I had the all you can eat sushi.  It was really good and thenorder seemed to come out pretty fast to the table once ordered.  I liked the playboy roll it had fresh tuna on top.  It's inside the casino which is fun as well.
Shoutout to Jamal for making our dining experience a memorable one! He was super attentive and helpful. The food is amazing and the portions are generous. Would definitely go back.

Wow this place is amazing. The decor is so cool. The staff is friendly. The cocktails are yummy!!! You won't leave this place thirsty or hungry  it's small portions so you can try a couple items. I recommend ordering 2-3 things per person unless you order an enchilada (see photo). You can mix and match the tacos, which come 3 to an order. The salsa and guacamole were a great starter while our food was cooked to perfection!
I don't see the hype of this place. Overpriced food, nothing special in my opinion. Even the diff flavors of bacon all seemed pretty basic to me. Wouldn't recommend
I decided to go here because I heard it was voted best chicken at the fried chicken festival and they did not disappoint. The chicken was well seasoned and steaming hot.

Arrived at 3ish on July 2nd and had to wait. 3 tables in the place and one server. Bartender and manger were standing around and useless! Waited a while for a server to come by as bartender and manger were standing at the bar. Over all very disappointed and really can not recommend to anyone!

I understand everyone struggling because of covid but this may affect if we ever order from here again. Food taste was still amazing don't get me wrong. We got dinner for four. My large artichoke and spinach sandwich which comes with mushrooms had more mushrooms then anything else. Still there wasn't enough to cover all the bread. I basically had a mushroom sandwich with a hint of artichoke and spinach. All of them were very skimpy but I was only able to get pictures of mine because everyone ate before me. I really wish I had pics of them all. Even the large salad was skimpy.  We had 4 pepperoni slices on the large salad. About a teaspoon of cheese and less then that of the onion and green pepper. Olives were a fair amount but I had asked for extra olives sooo.... The free cheese bread that came with the salad.... One slice of that was more filling them my whole sandwich which is crazy. Again food tasted good but was so skimpy what normally is a full meal with enough leftovers for the next day was more like a snack this time.
A great modern twist on Greek cuisine.  The bakery items are simply delicious.  Loved everything from the ambiance to the food and coffee, which was amazing
The bartender, Sarah, was amazing. Very accommodating with my husband wanting to sample a wine. Our charcuterie board was flawless. Highly recommend!

Visited this location while at a work convention.  I ordered on site and through the Yelp app. Both orders were correct and I received them in a timely manner.  I tried the orange ginger smoothie and a peanut paradise.  I'm not sure why this location has such a low rating.  It seemed clean and organized.
Service was great, we ordered a Matt Cain deep dish and it was well worth the wait! Also the beer selection is one of the best I've seen in town. Overall a great experience!

Many restaurants used the Covid-19 down time to remodel or update their restaurants. Tequila Sunrise did exactly that and has a totally new look. What use to be a true Mexican decor is now an upscale, modern atmosphere interior. The walls are now a soft cream, the new booth fabric is a taupe leather with a new layout in the main dining area and a large wall now separates the dining area from the front lobby. The private dining area along the side has gray, contempory sound proofing walls more for the design element than sound proofing. The large fountain area has been removed allowing for additional seating for large groups.

The menu remains the same but now on paper vs. the large, hardback menu. My favorite Chicken and Spinach Enchiladas was still on the menu. Three Enchiladas stuffed with chicken and spinach smothered in cheese sauce and served with rice (subbed beans) and a small salad was delicious. I'm glad they didn't change the menu but only the dated decor. 

Patio seating is available for a few more weeks, weather permitting. When I arrived the patio was closed but it October.

I always enjoy my Enchiladas, the service is good with affordable food and always on our tried and true list.

This was worst experience.  Arrived at 6:50 for 7:30 reservation.  30 ppl waiting.  They actually sat everyone else and sat all the 8 reservations and still did not come for us.  Went to ask what is going on.  Told coming now.  Waited  another 20-25 min and had to go back again.  They never should have taken reservation.  We were also looking at other restaurants in area like Davio's which we loved before.  

Would not recommend to anyone.   Ever.
go here and get the roast pork sandwich with broccoli rabe. ask for a side of the truffle mayo for the fries that are served with the sandwich. you won't regret it!!
